pairs.evidence: src/hooks/execution/useReasoningTrace.ts:100 coerces the optional ResultEvent.duration_ms (src/lib/types/terminalEvents.ts:56) to 0, and src/hooks/execution/useExecutionSummary.ts:82 hands it to src/features/agents/sub_executions/detail/views/ExecutionSummaryCard.tsx:124, whose != null guard cannot see the coercion, so an unmeasured run reads as 0 ms - re-verified 2026-10-12

techniques.evidence: src/hooks/execution/useReasoningTrace.ts:100 substitutes 0 for an absent measurement (the technique's never-coerce rule, applied to duration); cost on the next line correctly stays undefined

pairs.registryProposal: unpriced-span-accounting's never-coerce rule is stated for cost but bites identically on duration and tokens; the technique (or golden path) could name 'any nullable measure' explicitly so duration coercions are recognised as the same defect
